note.zh-CN: 2026 年全程终点调整至青山江滩，青山区首次进入汉马赛道；35 公里后改道白马道、飞雁路。
note.en: The 2026 full finish moved to Qingshan Riverside, bringing Qingshan into the course for the first time; after 35 km the route changed to Baima Dao and Feiyan Road.

details.direction: Sanyang Road, Yanjiang Avenue, Nanjing Road, Zhongshan Avenue, Wusheng Road, Jianghan Bridge, Yingwu Avenue, Guishan South Road, the Yangtze Bridge, Yellow Crane Tower South Road, Pengliuyang Road, Linjiang Avenue out-and-back, Xinsheng Road, Youyi Avenue, Shahu Bridge, Chuhan Road, Donghu Road, Bailu Street, Tian’e Road, Donghu South Road, the East Lake greenway, Feiyan Road out-and-back, Huanle Avenue, Renhe Road, Youyi Avenue, Jianshe 3rd Road and Qingshan Riverside.
details.distanceMethod: 2026 official regulations and course page give 42.2 km; this page does not average conflicting figures.
details.attribution: 武汉马拉松 2026：长江大桥、东湖绿道与青山江滩的七区连线 / Wuhan Marathon 2026: the Yangtze Bridge, East Lake greenway and a Qingshan finish. Race facts from the 2026 official notices and host-city government pages; editorial schematic only, no official track bundled.
